title: Auditing & Compliance with pgaudit
description: Track DDL and DML operations for compliance audits using the official pgaudit extension.

data.text: Standard PostgreSQL logging is designed for debugging, not compliance auditing. **`pgaudit` (PostgreSQL Audit Extension)** produces structured, tamper-resistant audit logs that fulfill compliance mandates by recording who accessed which tables and executed what statements.

data.title: Configuring pgaudit in postgresql.conf
data.content: Auditing role changes, DDL modifications, and table reads.
data.code:
# In postgresql.conf:
shared_preload_libraries = 'pgaudit'
pgaudit.log = 'role, ddl, write'
pgaudit.log_catalog = off
pgaudit.log_parameter = on

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: `pgaudit` satisfies SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS audit logging requirements.
Records user, session, command tag, statement text, and parameters.
Route audit logs to centralized SIEM tools like Splunk or Datadog.
